pairs.source: I prepared the agenda and recorded supplier feedback at a procurement workshop. The buyer facilitated the discussion.
pairs.good: Prepared the agenda and documented supplier feedback for a buyer-led procurement workshop.
pairs.bad: Prepared the agenda and led the supplier discussion at a procurement workshop.

pairs.source: I owned the help center taxonomy redesign from kickoff through launch. Two editors helped me tag articles.
pairs.good: Redesigned the help center taxonomy as project lead, working with two editors to tag articles.
pairs.bad: Redesigned the help center taxonomy under an editor’s direction, helping tag articles.

pairs.source: For a stock audit I counted and reconciled all items in my assigned aisle. The warehouse supervisor reconciled the other aisles and signed the final inventory.
pairs.good: Reconciled stock counts for an assigned aisle during the warehouse audit.
pairs.bad: Reconciled stock counts for the entire warehouse and signed off on the audit.

pairs.source: I made the go-live decision for the billing cutover and authorized the release. The shift engineer carried out my deployment plan.
pairs.good: Directed the billing cutover and authorized the shift engineer to deploy the release.
pairs.bad: Directed the billing cutover and personally deployed the release.

pairs.source: My barcode packing screen worked in a demo using dummy orders. We did not connect it to a warehouse or put it in service.
pairs.good: Built a barcode packing screen and demonstrated it with simulated orders.
pairs.bad: Built a barcode packing screen and deployed it for live warehouse orders.

pairs.source: I built and launched the customer status page. Paying customers used it to track incidents after launch.
pairs.good: Built the customer status page and released it for customers to track live incidents.
pairs.bad: Built the customer status page as an internal prototype using mock incidents.

pairs.source: I wrote a proposal for automatic shelf replenishment and presented it to store operations. No build or trial was approved.
pairs.good: Designed an automatic shelf replenishment workflow and presented the proposal to store operations.
pairs.bad: Designed an automatic shelf replenishment workflow and piloted it with store operations.

pairs.source: I configured the returns portal and ran a controlled pilot with invited merchants before the public release. My assignment ended after the pilot.
pairs.good: Configured the returns portal and ran a pilot with invited merchants.
pairs.bad: Configured the returns portal and launched it for all merchants.

pairs.source: At a clinic I organized the weekend reception rota. The office manager handled weekdays.
pairs.good: Coordinated weekend reception shifts for a clinic.
pairs.bad: Coordinated all reception shifts for a clinic.

pairs.source: I updated the fare tables for every route in the transit district, including all bus and ferry lines.
pairs.good: Updated fare tables across all bus and ferry routes in the transit district.
pairs.bad: Updated fare tables exclusively for the district’s bus routes.

pairs.source: I localized checkout messages into French for the Canadian store. The French store had separate copy and was outside my assignment.
pairs.good: Localized checkout messages into French for the Canadian store.
pairs.bad: Localized checkout messages into French for the Canadian and French stores.

pairs.source: I reviewed renewal terms for active enterprise customers. Another analyst reviewed small-business contracts.
pairs.good: Reviewed renewal terms for active enterprise accounts.
pairs.bad: Reviewed renewal terms for enterprise and small-business accounts.

pairs.source: I consolidated the weekly reporting files. Preparation time fell from five hours to three hours per week.
pairs.good: Consolidated weekly reporting files, cutting preparation time by two hours per week.
pairs.bad: Consolidated weekly reporting files, cutting preparation time by three hours per week.

pairs.source: I administered training registration. Eighty people registered, and 56 attended the session.
pairs.good: Managed training registration for 80 people, with 56 attending the session.
pairs.bad: Managed training registration for 56 people, with 80 attending the session.

pairs.source: I changed the volunteer reminder schedule. The share of shifts filled rose from 70 percent to 77 percent.
pairs.good: Revised volunteer reminders, raising the shift fill rate by 7 percentage points.
pairs.bad: Revised volunteer reminders, raising the shift fill rate by 7 percent relative to baseline.

pairs.source: I revised the quote intake form. The median turnaround fell from two business days to one. We did not track the average.
pairs.good: Revised quote intake, reducing median turnaround from two business days to one.
pairs.bad: Revised quote intake, reducing average turnaround from two business days to one.

pairs.source: I scheduled nightly exports with cron on Linux. I have never used Airflow on this project.
pairs.good: Scheduled nightly exports with cron on Linux.
pairs.bad: Scheduled nightly exports with Airflow on Linux.

pairs.source: I used Power Query in Excel to clean enrollment files. A teammate wrote the SQL used to extract the raw records.
pairs.good: Cleaned enrollment records with Excel Power Query using extracts supplied by a teammate.
pairs.bad: Cleaned enrollment records with SQL queries I wrote to extract and transform the data.

pairs.source: I replaced manual ticket tagging with a Python script I wrote and maintained. We had no commercial tagging product.
pairs.good: Automated ticket tagging with a custom Python script.
pairs.bad: Automated ticket tagging with a commercial tagging platform.

pairs.source: I coded interview notes by hand in a spreadsheet. I did not use an AI model or transcription service.
pairs.good: Coded interview notes by hand in a spreadsheet to organize participant feedback.
pairs.bad: Coded interview notes with an AI model to organize participant feedback.

pairs.source: I prepared a courier consolidation plan projecting $18,000 in annual savings. Finance had not approved implementation when I left.
pairs.good: Prepared a courier consolidation plan projecting $18,000 in annual savings.
pairs.bad: Prepared a courier consolidation plan that delivered $18,000 in annual savings.

pairs.source: I resolved duplicate freight charges and obtained $6,400 in refunds. All refunds appeared in the company account.
pairs.good: Resolved duplicate freight charges and recovered $6,400 in refunds.
pairs.bad: Resolved duplicate freight charges and projected $6,400 in potential refunds still awaiting payment.

pairs.source: I ran a controlled test of a shorter signup form. Completion was unchanged, so the team kept the original.
pairs.good: Tested a shorter signup form and found no change in completion.
pairs.bad: Tested a shorter signup form and increased completion.

pairs.source: I interviewed visitors about confusing signs and recommended a clearer layout. The museum had not replaced any signs by the end of my placement.
pairs.good: Interviewed museum visitors and recommended a clearer sign layout.
pairs.bad: Interviewed museum visitors and installed a clearer sign layout.

pairs.source: I assembled the budget figures for a grant application. The program director wrote the narrative and submitted the application.
pairs.good: Compiled budget figures for a grant application submitted by the program director.
pairs.bad: Compiled budget figures and submitted the grant application.

pairs.source: I supervised the night loading crew and signed off each shift’s dispatch log. There was no other night supervisor.
pairs.good: Coordinated night loading as crew supervisor and signed off on dispatch logs.
pairs.bad: Coordinated night loading under the crew supervisor, who signed off on dispatch logs.

pairs.source: I developed a digital intake form, then released it to patients at both practices. Reception retired the paper form after launch.
pairs.good: Developed a digital intake form and launched it for patients at both practices.
pairs.bad: Developed a digital intake form and stopped at a staff-only demonstration.

pairs.source: I assembled an air-quality monitor and tested it on a lab bench. Field deployment was deferred until after my internship.
pairs.good: Assembled an air-quality monitor and tested it on a lab bench.
pairs.bad: Assembled an air-quality monitor and deployed it in the field.

pairs.source: I translated receiving instructions into Polish at the north depot. The other depots continued to use English instructions.
pairs.good: Translated receiving instructions into Polish for the north depot.
pairs.bad: Translated receiving instructions into Polish for every depot.

pairs.source: I catalogued the library’s entire oral history collection, including reels, cassettes, and digital recordings.
pairs.good: Catalogued the library’s entire oral history collection across analog and digital formats.
pairs.bad: Catalogued only the digital recordings in the library’s oral history collection.

pairs.source: I introduced a fixture alignment check. Rejects fell from 12 units per batch to 8 units per batch.
pairs.good: Introduced a fixture alignment check, reducing rejects by four units per batch.
pairs.bad: Introduced a fixture alignment check, reducing rejects by eight units per batch.

pairs.source: I distributed a tenant survey to 240 households and received 90 completed responses.
pairs.good: Distributed a tenant survey to 240 households and collected 90 completed responses.
pairs.bad: Distributed a tenant survey to 240 households and collected 240 completed responses.

pairs.source: I made clickable interface mockups in Figma. A developer later implemented them in React.
pairs.good: Created clickable interface mockups in Figma for a developer to implement in React.
pairs.bad: Created clickable interface mockups in Figma and implemented them myself in React.

pairs.source: I wrote a Bash script to compare handheld scanner exports. The team did not have a database for the stocktake.
pairs.good: Compared handheld scanner exports using a Bash script written for the stocktake.
pairs.bad: Compared handheld scanner exports using SQL queries against the stocktake database.

pairs.source: I organized an alumni appeal with a $20,000 target. Donors contributed $16,500 by the close of the appeal.
pairs.good: Organized an alumni appeal that raised $16,500 toward a $20,000 target.
pairs.bad: Organized an alumni appeal that raised its full $20,000 target.

pairs.source: I replaced a faulty chiller seal and verified that leakage stopped. A cost estimate was outside the repair assignment.
pairs.good: Replaced a faulty chiller seal and verified that leakage stopped.
pairs.bad: Replaced a faulty chiller seal and verified $5,000 in maintenance savings.

probes.source: On Saturdays I trained six new cashiers to close their tills. The store manager handled performance reviews and supervision.
I built and bench-tested a prototype leak detector using an Arduino. It stayed in the lab.
I reorganized the repairs queue. At the start we had 48 overdue jobs and at the end we had 30.
I designed a plan to pool printing orders. It would save an estimated $9,000 a year if approved. The plan is awaiting approval.
I led the rollout of the digital room-booking system. It went live in all four conference centers.
I used QGIS to map bus stops that lacked shelters. The planning unit used my map to select sites for inspection.
